output_directory.description: Absolute output directory. The parent must exist. The directory itself must be absent unless resume is true. One run at a time may use a directory; a second run is refused while the first holds it.

layout.description: address names files by canonical address. dwarf asks for compilation-unit paths and is reported unavailable when the provider has no such fact.

resume.description: Continue a journal for the same target SHA-256, provider, analysis profile, and layout. Both digests must be known. Verified files and functions recorded as external are skipped, conflicting files are left unchanged, and functions not yet tried run before retries of recorded failures.

retry_failed.description: For a null result explicitly reported as a function failure, retain the failure and try an independent decompile when supported. It can use different analysis context; errors and omissions without that typed fact are not retried.

name.description: Case-sensitive literal substring of the provider function name.

namespace.description: Case-sensitive prefix of the provider function name, including any separator such as Foo:: or Class.

address_start.description: Inclusive lower bound as 0xoffset or space:0xoffset. Must use the same address space as address_end.

address_end.description: Inclusive upper bound as 0xoffset or space:0xoffset. Must use the same address space as address_start.

limit.description: Maximum functions to attempt on this call after skipping verified files and functions recorded as external. Further matches remain for a later resume.

duration_ms.description: Observation window; the process is killed if it is still running.

max_events.description: Stop observing and kill the process after this many recorded entries.

native_command_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock budget in milliseconds for each macOS native command in this call (lipo, codesign, plutil, swift-demangle, and the other allowlisted Xcode tools). Omitted means 60000. Integer from 1 to 2147483647. Applies on the next call. Does not raise the fixed 67108864-byte output allowance or the 65536-byte failure-diagnostic excerpt. Named native_command_timeout_ms rather than command_timeout_ms because command_timeout_ms is the separate one-shot objdump and rizin deadline (default 120000).

inputSchema.description: Provide a complete input group: path + operation + [follow_debug_links] + [command_timeout_ms] + [max_output_bytes] + [detail]; path + operation + [follow_debug_links] + [command_timeout_ms] + [max_output_bytes] + [symbol] + [detail]; operation + [command_timeout_ms] + [max_output_bytes] + [detail].

path.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.

asm_arch.description: Rizin arch plugin, passed as -a, such as arm. Plugins differ between builds; e asm.arch=? lists them.

asm_bits.description: Rizin asm.bits, passed as -b, such as 16 for Thumb. Omitted, Rizin's default applies.

asm_cpu.description: Rizin asm.cpu, passed as -e asm.cpu=, such as cortexm; e asm.cpu=? lists those of the selected arch.

base_address.description: Address of file offset 0. REA passes -n and -m, so Rizin maps the file there as a raw image, reads no format headers, and keeps its default decoder unless asm_arch and asm_bits select one.

command_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock budget in milliseconds. Target preflight shares one budget across stat and digest, and the one-shot command receives that budget again (default 120000 each). Omitted means 120000. Applies on the next call. Output admission is separately controlled by max_output_bytes; does not raise Ghidra or Hopper startup deadlines or debugger session deadlines.

max_output_bytes.description: Combined stdout/stderr byte budget before decoding (default 16777216, range 1..44651859). Applies on the next call without restarting REA. The maximum reserves JSON-escaping space for both Evidence mirrors under Node's single-string ceiling. Reaching it stops collection and requests provider termination; completion remains unknown. Confirm effects and cleanup before repeating a command. Does not raise the MCP client's receive buffer.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback CDP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:PORT, or ws://127.0.0.1:PORT/devtools/browser/ID.

discovery_timeout_ms.description: Loopback CDP HTTP discovery per-response deadline and browser-socket handshake plus discovery (Browser.getVersion, Target.getTargets) deadline in milliseconds (default 10000). Omitted means 10000 and applies on the next call. Separate from command_timeout_ms, the caller observation window, and the 5000 ms cleanup grace. Does not raise the fixed HTTP discovery document or WebSocket protocol byte budgets, which have no runtime override.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.

command_timeout_ms.description: CDP WebSocket handshake and per-command response deadline in milliseconds (default 20000). Omitted means 20000 and applies on the next call. deadlineExpired for a handshake or command is not the caller observation window, not the CDP discovery deadline (default 10000 ms, or discovery_timeout_ms where supported), and not the 5000 ms cleanup grace. It also bounds passive script-source collection and the inspection/source-join phase that share this deadline. Does not raise the fixed protocol, retained-event, or source byte budgets, or the cleanup grace, which have no runtime override.

include_accessibility_text.description: Whether to include accessibility text in the result.

include_console_text.description: Whether to include console text in the result.

include_json_body_shapes.description: Whether to include json body shapes in the result.

include_websocket_shapes.description: Whether to include websocket shapes in the result.

include_storage_keys.description: Whether to include storage keys in the result.

include_storage_fingerprints.description: Whether to include storage fingerprints in the result.

include_script_sources.description: Whether to include script sources in the result.

semantic_precision.description: Per-script semantic evaluator budgets; omitted fields preserve defaults. Independent of worker memory, deadlines and reply budgets.

source_map_limits.description: Source-map fetch/representation and decoder admission for this call. Omitted fields keep existing defaults; no restart required.

max_heap_mb.description: Heap phase: maximum V8 old-space for the isolated inert-script analyzer, in MiB (default 1024, range 128..16384). Omitted means 1024 and applies on the next call. This is not a total process RSS limit, not analysis_timeout_ms, and not total_analysis_timeout_ms. Bun ignores V8 flags; Windows Bun uses an owned process commit limit plus a 512 MiB runtime reserve, while other Bun hosts have no enforced memory limit. Raising max_heap_mb does not raise the fixed worker protocol or result byte budgets.

analysis_timeout_ms.description: Per-script deadline phase: maximum startup, analysis and result transfer time for one captured script, in milliseconds (default 30000, range 1..2147483647). Omitted means 30000. deadlineExpired for one script is not total_analysis_timeout_ms. A per-script value above the effective total is rejected. Timed-out scripts are explicit unknowns and other scripts may still be analyzed. Applies on the next call.

total_analysis_timeout_ms.description: Total analysis deadline phase: maximum time for all captured-script analysis, in milliseconds (default 300000, range 1..2147483647). Omitted means 300000. This is not the per-script analysis_timeout_ms, not capture, and not source-map fetch. A per-script timeout above this total is rejected. Unstarted scripts remain explicit unknowns. Applies on the next call.

source_map_fetch_timeout_ms.description: Source-map fetch deadline in milliseconds (default 30000). Omitted means 30000 and applies on the next fetch. After response cleanup completes, a fetch overrun is an item limitation (fetch_failed), not a thrown analysis timeout. Pending or failed response cleanup is reported as an error with its retained owner. Response/representation and decoder budgets are independent source_map_limits fields.

format.description: Explicit interpretation: dos-com or raw-binary (headerless), gamecube-dol (GameCube/Wii DOL, never auto-detected), or esp-flash-image (an ESP flash dump read with flash_offset and partition_table_offset). Omission preserves header-based detection.

architecture.description: Caller-supplied CPU family. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. format=gamecube-dol takes powerpc from the header, so it must be omitted.

entry_point.description: Caller-supplied load and entry address (0xhex). File offset 0 is mapped here. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. Optional with format=gamecube-dol; must equal the DOL header entry.

flash_offset.description: Flash address (0xhex) of the dump's first byte, when it does not start at flash address 0. Only with format=esp-flash-image.

partition_table_offset.description: Flash address (0xhex, a multiple of 0x1000) of the partition table, which disables the table scan. Only with format=esp-flash-image.

provider_id.description: Exact deep-analysis provider ID, or automatic selection when omitted.
